ref.locator: titres-services.wallonie.be 'tableau_indexation.pdf' (Updated: 08/2026), PDF page 4 (Walloon section; page 3 is the 'Région Wallone' header page), table 'Processus de remboursement du titre-service de la Région Wallonne depuis le 01/01/2026', row 'Titres-services émis après le 01/07/2026' / 'Prestation après le 01/07/2026'; purchase price from titres-services.wallonie.be news 'Adaptation de la valeur de remboursement des titres-services' (15 May 2026), 'Nouvelles valeurs faciales des titres-services', first line
ref.quote: Titres-services émis après le 01/07/2026 ... Prestation après le 01/07/2026 30,95 €  ||  10,60 EUR pour les 175 premiers titres-services acquis par année civile ;
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: Both sources re-downloaded: 30,95 € is on PDF page 4 (confirmed by per-page extraction; page 2 is the Flemish table mislabelled 'Région Wallonne'), and 10,60 EUR is on the 15 May 2026 news page. Arithmetic: 30.95 − 10.60 = 20.35; cross-check 30.75 − 10.40 = 20.35; first half 2026: 30.55 − 10.40 = 20.15. Value confirmed. Label corrected: 'hours ... paid by the Walloon Region' reads as if the Region pays the whole hour, whereas it pays only the share above the user's price (20,35 of 30,95 €); the new label says the hours are subsidised and the unit is the regional share. 20,35 € holds only for titres bought at the first-tier 10,60 € price; at 11,60 / 12,60 € the Region's share is lower (assuming the reimbursement value does not vary with the tier: the table gives one value per issue date and the news says the 0,20 € rise follows the price rise, but neither text states the tier rule explicitly). Issuer fees not included. The Walloon tax reduction applies only to purchases up to 31/12/2025, so it does not add to the 2026 cost per titre. Titres-services sit in this line (wallonia.json note: programme 18.130 consolidates former 18.106 titres-services). The source is a Pluxee-made table hosted on the official Walloon titres-services site; the legal basis (AGW) could not be fetched from Wallex (404 at the ELI tried), so the researcher's statements about the 2023 reform and the 18 Dec 2025 AGW were not verified. Researcher's working: Reimbursement value paid to the company per titre (30.95 €) − price paid by the user for that titre (10.60 €) = 20.35 € paid by the Region. Cross-check from the same table: titres bought at 10.40 € (issued after 01/07/2025) used after 01/07/2026 are reimbursed 30.75 €, and 30.75 − 10.40 = 20.35 €. This is the regional intervention per titre from 1 July 2026 (it was 20.15 € in the first half of 2026: 30.55 − 10.40, same table). Titres bought at the higher tiers (11.60 € / 12.60 € after 175 or 400 titres a year) carry a correspondingly smaller regional share, because the reimbursement value is the same. Excludes the issuer's management fees, which the same budget article (130.007, 576.752 k EUR adjusted 2026) also pays, and excludes any user tax reduction (the table shows the Walloon deduction only for purchases up to 31/12/2025). The PDF is a Pluxee-made table hosted on the official titres-services.wallonie.be site; the Flemish section on page 2 is mistakenly also headed 'Région Wallonne', so use page 4 (the page after the 'Région Wallone' header page). The legal basis is the AR of 12 Dec 2001 as amended by the Walloon Government (2023 reform: 18.98 € from 1 Jan 2024, indexed since; 2026 indexation halved to 1% by the AGW of 18 Dec 2025, wallex ELI 2025009903). Titres-services are only part of the line, which is mostly FOREM.
